whenToUse: A tabbed category module on a news front ("Don't miss") with one tab per section.
Section tabs that must fold into a More menu when the column is narrow.
avoidWhen: Navigation between pages — use navbar or section-nav.
a11y: WAI-ARIA tabs: arrow keys, Home and End; the selected tab always stays in the visible row.
Panels loaded on first open show a loading state and are cached per tab.
